envelope.reason: operator: the wizard tells the user what it will do and asks to confirm the symlinked launchers

payload.title: omp install asks before linking persona commands
payload.body: Operator ruling: the omp install wizard states what it will place for persona launch (one ~/.local/bin/<persona> symlink per installed persona, pointing at ~/.omp/agent/omp-agent, never overwriting a file it did not place) and asks the user to confirm before creating the links. A non-interactive install creates none unless asked (e.g. a flag), and says how to add them. Until this ships, a host gets the links by hand: mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && for f in ~/.omp/agent/agents/*.md; do n=$(basename "$f" .md); [ -e ~/.local/bin/"$n" ] || ln -s ~/.omp/agent/omp-agent ~/.local/bin/"$n"; done
